task.title: Web view drag and drop improvements: target should be full column, allow reordering
task.description:
The web view drag and drop requires dropping a story onto a constrained target made up of the current stories in that column (or a small box if there are no stories). When dragging a story from the bottom of a long column to a shorter column (e.g. backlog to ready), the user has to scroll the window back up while dragging to find the target. The drop target should be the full column container.

Additionally, dragging a story within a column should allow reordering using the `workbook move` command.
